function.name: getMeetingTranscriptFunc
function.description: Retrieves the transcript of a meeting including details such as topics, agendas, and discussions. If a duration is not specified, the transcript for the last 10 minutes will be fetched. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content: I’m happy to help you find out whether you have any tasks assigned in your current meeting. To do that, I’ll need the unique identifier for the meeting you’re referring to. Could you please provide the meeting ID (or let me know if you’d like me to look up the most recent meeting you joined)? Once I have that, I can pull the latest transcript and look for any task assignments that mention your name.
